title: Persona fleet and persona health ignore the record owner and show a default instead
change: In services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py, added persona.get('owner') after metadata owner_id and before the existing 'pathreon-management' default in the owner expressions of _project_persona_fleet_row_impl and _build_persona_health_items_impl. No helper refactoring, sibling projection changes, default rename, metadata write/backfill, or frontend changes.

verification_commands.result: Provisioned .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 and verified imports from foreign cwd.

acceptance_criteria.1_fleet_top_level_owner: GET /bff/management/persona-fleet returns persona.get('owner') when metadata has neither owner nor owner_id; covered by test_persona_fleet_returns_top_level_owner_and_filters_by_q_when_metadata_lacks_owner in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_b3_persona_fleet.py.

acceptance_criteria.3_persona_health_top_level_owner: GET /bff/v5/execution/persona-health returns persona.get('owner') when metadata has neither owner nor owner_id; covered by test_v5_execution_persona_health_returns_top_level_owner_and_preserves_precedence_and_default in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_persona_health_single_owner.py.
acceptance_criteria.4_metadata_precedence: metadata['owner'] then metadata['owner_id'] keep precedence over top-level owner in both routes; covered by test_persona_fleet_owner_precedence_and_default_fallback and test_v5_execution_persona_health_returns_top_level_owner_and_preserves_precedence_and_default.
